scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: You know... this place doesn't seem to be safe for you. Please return to me once you have achieved ^0000FFLevel 99^000000 or higher.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: What did you see in there?!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.

scripts.text: You wish to relive the past again?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Though I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: I am glad to hear that! Maybe someday you can be as brave as old Leon the Lion!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.

scripts.text: What did you see in there?!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Excuse my rudeness! I am Pon de Leon, the famous adventurer!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: My friends call me Leon the Lion! For my tough appearance and attitude. Plus I have quite the bite!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: You know, this is such a strange location...

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: As you explore it you start to see cracks in space and time. Each one covered by a dimensional device.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: For example, I think I have caught glimpses of Payon through the one closest to us. But it doesn't seem right. Almost like it is a little bit older than it should be.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: I want to explore it, but with my old age and my knees I don't seem to be quite up to the task.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: So, I would like to ask something of you.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Though; I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Hey! You are too young to be playing with that! Come back when you are at least ^0000FFLevel 99^000000!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Before you go playing around with that; Why don't you come over here and talk to me?

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Leon
scripts.text: Before you enter you need to organize a party! Don't you know how? Type /organize PARTYNAMEHERE.
^FF0000The dimensional device boots up cleanly. Use the device to enter the crack in space and time.^000000

Where am I?

scripts.speaker: A Girl
scripts.text: Hello! This is the village of Payon. You don't seem to be from around here...
Are you from here? You don't seem to quite match the locals either.

scripts.speaker: A Girl
scripts.text: Yes! I was born here! My name is Sara, Sara Irene!

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: My father is doyen of this village! I just take after my mother.
Oh! I am sorry! Uh... Why are you standing out here all alone?

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: I am waiting for my father. He said that he will be here soon.
^FF0000An older man exits the house. Sara's face brightens at the sight of him.^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Hi Daddy!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Sweetheart you look so happy.

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: You said you would come back soon! I waited for you and you lied!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Sweetheart, I am sorry I made you wait so long. The meeting with the village elders took longer than expected.

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: I hate those old fogeys.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Don't say that sweetheart... Who is this with you?
^FF0000Doyen Irene stares at you with fire in his eyes.^000000
^FF0000Sara starts humming and singing softly to herself. She picks some wild flowers nearby and presents them to the Doyen.^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Here you go daddy!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Oh Sara, may I have them?

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Of course silly daddy!
^FF0000After being given the flowers the Doyen's mood seems to greatly improve.^000000

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Alright my princess, where should we go now?

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Oh daddy! Lets go to the top of that hill over there!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Hah! Ok, hold onto me tight!
^FF0000As they wander off you hear strange voices from around the corner...^000000

scripts.speaker: Strange Old Man
scripts.text: I can feel Sara's power growing. We cannot just stand by and let her achieve her full potential!

scripts.speaker: Mysterious Old Man
scripts.text: She was born under a bad sign and her mother isn't even one of us!

scripts.speaker: Mysterious Old Man
scripts.text: Someday she will cause blood to flow in our streets.

scripts.speaker: Strange Old Man
scripts.text: We have to do something before the Holy creatures select her. I asked 'HIM' to take care of it.

scripts.speaker: Mysterious Old Man
scripts.text: We will see... I look forward to hearing the bad news that has befallen her...
^FF0000The old men wander off. It seems Sara might be in danger. We have to do something!^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Oh! Hello again! I remember you, what's up?

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: I am here to give flowers to my mommy!
^FF0000Sara leaps forward to open the door, flowers at the ready.^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Mom! Dad! Look what I found!
^FF0000The door opens to reveal a woman near death laying on the floor and the Doyen standing over the woman with a bloody sword.^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara's Mother
scripts.text: Sara...Ru-...away...
^FF0000A gem rolls from the woman's hand and comes to a rest in front of Sara. Unconsciously Sara reaches down and picks up the gem.^000000
^FF0000The Doyen turns around and notices Sara.^000000

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Ahh Sara! I was just looking for you...
Escape with Sara.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Guards! GUARDS!! There is a murderer here! Catch him!
^FF0000The sound of many pairs of boots can be heard running outside!^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Mommy NO!!!!!!!!!!
^FF0000Sara runs away and the sound of the guards is getting closer...^000000

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: Mommy!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Sara...

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: No!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: I have been looking for you Sara. Please come with daddy, it is very dangerous here!
I won't let you take Sara!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: The murderer is here! Guards! We will finish him once and for all!
Sara... run! Save yourself!

scripts.speaker: Sara Irene
scripts.text: ...okay.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: You... were too strong for me.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Why... *hack* are you trying to kill my wife and daughter?
What are you talking about? We saw you standing over Sara's mother with your sword COVERED in blood!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: You... think I killed Sara's mother?

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: She *cough* had already been stabbed by an assassin. I slew him *hack* that is why my blade was covered in blood...
^FF0000Thinking back, you seem to recall another body laying in the left corner of the room. Maybe that was the assassin the Doyen is talking about.^000000

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: If... you are the not the assassin sent to kill my wife and daughter, who are you?
I am just an adventurer who was passing through. I heard some strange men plotting their deaths and needed to intervene.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: If... you are telling the truth... forgive me. I thought you were one of them.

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: Strange men? ...I bet they were some of the village elders. Ugh...

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: There might be more assassins so we have to find Sara as fast as we can!
Sara believes that you killed her mother. We need to tell her the truth!

scripts.speaker: Doyen Irene
scripts.text: We must do our best to find her. Lets split up and search for her. Please help me find my daughter and explain everything to her.
^FF0000As you are about to call out to Sara, a sudden blow knocks you down from behind.^000000
The time travellers cannot interfere any longer. You cannot stop us from meeting Sara.
You should go back to the time where you belong.
^FF0000As you fall to the ground, two dark figures approach Sara.^000000
A girl full of betrayal, despair, and hate. We will guide you to your ultimate fate.
Sara Irene, 'he' will make your dreams come true.
^FF0000One of the cloaked strangers covers Sara with their cloak and all three figures disappear.^000000
